options.name: addr
options.description: The IP address or network of the RADIUS client(s) in CIDR notation. This is the IP of the NAS (switch, access point, firewall, router, etc.)

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: description
options.description: The description for this interface.

options.name: ip_version
options.description: The IP version of the this Client.

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: maxconn
options.description: Takes only effect if you use TCP as protocol. Limits the number of simultaneous TCP connections from a client.

options.name: msgauth
options.description: RFC5080 requires Message-Authenticator in Access-Request. But older NAS (switches or accesspoints) do not include that.

options.name: naslogin
options.description: If supported by your NAS, you can use SNMP or finger for simultaneous-use checks instead of (s)radutmp file and accounting. Leave empty to choose (s)radutmp.

options.name: naspassword
options.description: If supported by your NAS, you can use SNMP or finger for simultaneous-use checks instead of (s)radutmp file and accounting. Leave empty to choose (s)radutmp.

options.name: nastype
options.description: The NAS type of the client. This is used by checkrad.pl for simultaneous use checks.

options.name: proto
options.description: The protocol the client uses.

options.name: secret
options.description: This is the shared secret (password) which the NAS (switch, accesspoint, etc.) needs to communicate with the RADIUS server.

options.name: shortname
options.description: A short name for the client. This is generally the hostname of the NAS.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
